HeyCharge started when our founders experienced firsthand the challenge of charging an EV without a private garage. Living in an apartment building with underground parking, they discovered that installing a charger meant navigating impossible infrastructure requirements.
The solution? Build charging infrastructure that doesn't need any infrastructure. No internet. No network cables. No SIM cards. Just Bluetooth, cryptography, and a radically simple approach.
Today, HeyCharge powers charging for thousands of EV drivers across Europe and the US, proving that apartment dwellers deserve the same easy charging experience as homeowners.
